events.text: Marape was elected as alternate Prime Minister.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He was elected as alternate Prime Minister on 7th of May 2019 .

events.text: The Ombudsman Commission recommended that a leadership tribunal judge ONeill and Marape over the UBS loan.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On the 17th of May the Ombudsman Commission recommended that a leadership tribunal judge ONeill and Marape

events.text: Marape was replaced as alternate MP by Patrick Pruaitch.
events.subject: self
events.quote: the reason for Marapes replacement as alternate MP by Patrick Pruaitch on 28 of May 2019

events.text: Peter O’Neill resigned as Prime Minister.
events.subject: other
events.quote: Peter O’Neill had then resigned as Prime Minister on 26th of May .

events.text: Marape obtained 101 votes in the subsequent election for Prime Minister.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Marape obtained in the subsequent election 101 votes as compared to 8 for Mekere Morauta .

events.text: Marape accepted the leadership of Pangu Party.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In August 2019 , he accepted the leadership of Pangu Party.

events.text: In a Cabinet reshuffle Marape replaced most of the Cabinet Ministers.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In a Cabinet reshuffle on 8th of November Marape replaced most of the Cabinet Ministers .

events.text: Marape was confronted by an attempt to topple him from power.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On 10th of November 2020 Marape was confronted by an attempt to topple him from power .

events.text: A motion of no confidence in the Marape government could be mounted after the grace period expired.
events.subject: self
events.quote: A motion of no confidence in the Marape government could be mounted after 30th of November

events.text: A motion by Belden Namah was accepted to adjourn Parliament to 1st of December.
events.subject: other
events.quote: A motion by Belden Namah was accepted ( 57-39 ) to adjourn Parliament to 1st of December

events.text: The budget for 2021 was passed with the opposition absent in Vanimo.
events.subject: self
events.quote: on 17 of November -with the opposition absent in Vanimo- the budget for 2021 was passed .

events.subject: other
events.quote: Parliament was then adjourned until April 2021.

events.text: Marape reversed the replacement of the Private Business committee members and brought his own supporters on the committee.
events.subject: self
events.quote: Marape reversed this and brought his own supporters on the committee in the session of 17th of November
